text: The authors take prover-verifier games, introduced by Anil et al. (2021) as a game-theoretic framework for verifiable decision making, and formalise a generalisation of them based on messaging games with one or more provers and verifiers. They say the generalised definition captures other protocols such as debate as well as the new protocols they introduce.
title: Hammond et al. generalise Anil et al.'s prover-verifier games to multi-agent messaging games
